text.p: Following are some of the leading stories in Norwegian papers this morning:
- Tourists from all over the world want to celebrate New Years Eve 2000 at Nordkapphallen tourist centre at Norway's North Cape.
- Adventurer Borge Ousland reached the South Pole on skis on Thursday. Ousland's goal is to ski alone across the entire Antarctic continent.

- The coffins with the two Norwegian nurses killed in Russia's breakaway republic Chechnya arrived at Fornebu airport in Oslo on Thursday night. Six foreign aid workers working at a Red Cross hospital were killed on Tuesday.

- Norway's mainland economic growth is expected to slow down over the next two years with domestic demand forecast to expand only moderately and non-oil exports to progressively lose competitiveness, the OECD said on Thursday.
- Fredriksen shipping group has signed an intentional agreement with Texaco on use of Fredriksen's production rig "Northern Producer" on the Galley field in the North Sea.
